videos.title: The Death of the Code Review: What the Data Actually Says — Laurie Voss, Arize AI
videos.summary: AI agents have unlocked a 740% surge in code generation, yet engineering teams are only shipping 30% more software because manual code review has become an impossible bottleneck. This talk delivers the roadmap for the next era of development: why you must stop reviewing individual pull requests and start engineering the automated rubrics, evaluation harnesses, and runtime observability systems that make AI code genuinely safe to ship.
